svg.aria-label: The VGA palette: a pixel holds an index, the palette maps it to 6-bit red, green and blue; two common 6-to-8-bit conversions differ, and colour cycling changes the palette, not the pixels
svg.title: The VGA palette: a pixel holds an index, the palette maps it to 6-bit red, green and blue; two common 6-to-8-bit conversions differ, and colour cycling changes the palette, not the pixels
svg.text: Pixels hold an index. The palette gives each index 6 bits of red, green and blue (0 to 63).
6 bits to 8 bits: two formulas, different on 30 of 64 values
red marks: v = 33 gives 133 by the first and 134 by the second. Compare with captures of the original.
Colour cycling rotates the palette entries and leaves the pixels unchanged
A capture of video memory alone misses fades, flashes and cycling. Capture the palette every frame.
